senses.definition: present participle and gerund of relate
The act of relating, or forming or identifying relationships; relation.

quotes.text: Such a dynamic, biological concept of consciousness as reflecting ever-shifting 'global mappings' in the brain, ceaseless relatings of current perceptions to past mappings, has been articulated with great force recently, by Gerald Edelman.
What makes a complex practice like education or medicine distinctive is the content of sayings, doings and relatings characteristic of the practice[…]
